summary: The eps 48-63 'anchor gap' is not a research hole — it is a 16-episode block that adapts ZERO manga chapters, so no anchors are possible and none are fabricated. Eps 49-63 are the Fugitive Arc, an anime-only story (Xeno/Lilith/Giev/Charon, all anime-exclusive characters) announced by Toei as 'an original story that was not in Daisuke Ashihara's manga' (ANN, 2015-07-22) and retconned out of continuity by Season 2; the fandom arc page gives Chapter = N/A and episodes 49-63 exactly. Ep 48 ('And Towards Tomorrow') is a separate anime-original breather episode filed under the canon B-Rank Wars Arc: its fandom infobox has no |Chapter field (canon neighbors 47 and 64 both carry one) and its content (Osamu's 50-loss mock-battle gauntlet, the Forbidden Zone kid) appears nowhere in the manga; most filler guides nonetheless count it canon (filler = 49-63), so it is typed anime-only-canon rather than filler. The boundary seam is airtight and the existing anchors need no repair: ep 47 ends at ch 103 (fandom |Chapter = 102-103) and ep 64 resumes at exactly ch 104 (fandom |Chapter = 104) — the anime skips nothing across the block, so a reader's position throughout eps 48-63 is simply 'through ch 103, resume at 104'. Deliverables are therefore type_corrections (currently all 16 rows are mis-typed canon) plus side_story annotations, with re-verified boundary anchors for eps 47 and 64.

annotations.note: Anime-original breather episode inside the canon B-Rank Wars Arc: Osamu's mock-battle gauntlet (35 losses to Kitora, then Midorikawa/Yoneya/Arafune/Utagawa/Kumagai/Kuroe/Sasamori) and the Forbidden Zone kid rescue — none of it in the manga; fandom episode infobox carries no |Chapter field while eps 47 and 64 both do.

Fugitive Arc, anime-only (fandom arc page: Chapter = N/A, episodes 49-63): Tamakoma-2 at the Shizuka City training camp meets fugitives Xeno and Lilith, pursued by Giev and Charon — all four anime-exclusive characters. Toei/ANN announced it as 'an original story that was not in Daisuke Ashihara's manga' (initially a tentative spin-off). Season 2 retconned it: the arc pushed the rank-war dates back a week and S2 reverted them to the manga's dates.

Title variants: our ep 48 'Then Towards Tomorrow' = fandom 'And Towards Tomorrow' (そして明日へ); MAL calls ep 52 'The Sunset of Meeden' (ours 'Sunset in Another World'), ep 60 'The Adventure of Yotaro' (ours 'Yotaro's Adventure').
